What is the Basilica of Bom Jesus known for?

The Basilica of Bom Jesus is famous for housing the mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier, a revered Christian missionary. It is also a UNESCO World Heritage Site and one of the finest examples of baroque architecture in India.

Where is the Basilica of Bom Jesus located?

The Basilica of Bom Jesus is located in Old Goa, around 10 km from Panjim, the capital of Goa. It is a major pilgrimage site and a key tourist attraction.

What are the visiting hours of the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

The Basilica of Bom Jesus is open to visitors from 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM on weekdays and from 10:30 AM to 6:30 PM on Sundays. The mass timings may vary.

Is there an entry fee for the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

No, entry to the Basilica of Bom Jesus is free for all visitors. However, donations are welcome for the maintenance of the church.

What is the significance of St. Francis Xavier’s remains in the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

The Basilica of Bom Jesus preserves the well-preserved mortal remains of St. Francis Xavier, which are displayed every ten years for public viewing during the Exposition.

How to reach the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

The Basilica of Bom Jesus is well-connected by road. Visitors can take a taxi, rent a scooter, or use public buses from Panjim or other parts of Goa to reach the church.

What is the best time to visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

The best time to visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus is between November and February, when the weather is pleasant. Visiting during the Feast of St. Francis Xavier (December 3rd) is especially special.

Are photography and videography allowed inside the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

Yes, photography is allowed inside the Basilica of Bom Jesus, but flash photography and videography may be restricted in certain areas to preserve the artifacts.

Is there a dress code for the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

Visitors to the Basilica of Bom Jesus are advised to dress modestly, covering their shoulders and knees, as it is a place of worship.

Are there any nearby attractions to the Basilica of Bom Jesus?

Yes, near the Basilica of Bom Jesus, you can visit Se Cathedral, Church of St. Francis of Assisi, Archaeological Museum of Goa, and St. Augustine’s Tower, all within walking distance in Old Goa.

The oldest church in Goa is the Church of Our Lady of the Rosary, located on Monte Santo (Holy Hill) in Old Goa. Built between 1510 and 1547, this historic church is one of the first to be constructed by the Portuguese after their conquest of Goa. It was commissioned by Afonso de Albuquerque, the Portuguese general who led the conquest, as a tribute to his victory. The church features Manueline and Gothic architectural styles, with a simple yet elegant structure made of laterite stone. Unlike the grand Baroque churches of Old Goa, it has a modest design with minimal ornamentation, reflecting the early days of Portuguese rule. Inside, it houses a beautiful altar dedicated to Our Lady of the Rosary, along with tombstones of Portuguese nobles. The church is now recognized as a UNESCO World Heritage Site, preserving its historical and religious significance.
